场景：SEEKER says: Hi friend. Can you recommend some good classic movies?
RECOMMENDER says: Sure! But by classic do you mean before the 70s or after?
SEEKER says: After
RECOMMENDER says: Okay, How about Indecent Proposal (1993)  ? Demi Moor and Woodie Harrleson.
SEEKER says: No, too risque for me
RECOMMENDER says: Okay, what about Sleepless in Seattle (1993)  ? Hanks and Ryan?；我执侧重：事件与SEEKER相关，执取未明确；法执侧重：相关事物按字面理解
